title: Gaza Health Ministry: 1,534 Killed Since Ceasefire; 7 Deaths in 24 Hours
detail: Gaza's Health Ministry reported 1,534 people killed and 5,486 injured since the ceasefire took effect on Oct 10, 2025, with 841 bodies recovered from areas Israeli forces withdrew from. Seven deaths and 24 injuries were logged in the latest 24 hours. Single-source report; no cumulative toll was stated.

media.caption: Gaza death toll since ceasefire rises to 1,534
